title: EARS Requirement
description: Schema-validated JSON record for one EARS-syntax requirement line, cross-referenced by id from spec.md and used to seed property-based tests.

id.description: Matches the FR-xxx id used in spec.md.

pattern.description: Which of the five EARS patterns this line follows.

trigger.description: The WHEN/WHILE/WHERE/IF condition. Null only for the ubiquitous pattern.

actor.description: The system or component the SHALL applies to.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given/When/Then scenarios, linked 1+ per requirement -- these seed both hand-written and property-based test generation.

testable.description: Whether ears-sensibility-gate (or equivalent review) judged this requirement to have a deterministic, observable oracle.
